speaker: Doctor
text: Let me start by asking: How long have you been experiencing these feelings of weakness and fatigue?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your recent travel and hiking activities, have you experienced any fever, chills, or muscle pain alongside this weakness?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The combination of worsening fatigue, difficulty with self-care, and new-onset mild diplopia (double vision) is highly suggestive of this neuromuscular junction disorder. I do not require further testing to make this clinical diagnosis based on the specific symptom profile provided.
